tools.name: agentdocs_listProjects
tools.description: List all documentation projects for the current brand. Returns project metadata: name, slug, page count, description.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_getProject
tools.description: Get a single documentation project by slug or UUID. Returns project metadata including page count and settings.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_listPages
tools.description: List all pages in a documentation project. Returns the page tree with slugs, titles, paths, and sort order.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_getPage
tools.description: Read a documentation page. Returns full content (no truncation), title, slug, version, tags, and revision metadata.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_createPage
tools.description: Create a new documentation page in a project. Creates the first revision. Returns the created page with content.

commit_message.description: Describes what was created and why

tags.description: Array of tag strings for categorization

slug.description: Custom slug (auto-generated from title if omitted)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_updatePage
tools.description: Update an existing documentation page. Creates a new immutable revision. Deduplicates identical content automatically.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_deletePage
tools.description: Soft-delete a documentation page. The page can be recovered but will no longer appear in listings or search.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_searchDocs
tools.description: Full-text search across all pages in the brand's documentation. Searches titles and content. Supports filtering by project, tags, and author type.

project_id.description: Scope search to a specific project (slug or UUID)

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_updateTheme
tools.description: Update the visual theme for a documentation project — colors, fonts, layout, logo, footer, and custom CSS. Changes are reflected on the public docs site immediately.

theme.description: Theme settings (colors, fonts, layout, logo, footer, customCss)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_deleteProject
tools.description: Delete a documentation project and all its pages. This is destructive and cannot be undone.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_movePage
tools.description: Move a documentation page to a different folder or change its sort order within the current folder.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_createProject
tools.description: Create a new documentation project. Returns the project with its ID and slug.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_updateProject
tools.description: Update a documentation project's name, description, or visibility.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_pageHistory
tools.description: Get revision history for a page. Returns all past versions with dates and authors.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_pageDiff
tools.description: Compute unified diff between two revisions. Omit from_rev for parent comparison.

from_rev.description: From revision ID (omit for parent comparison)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_pageRollback
tools.description: Rollback a page to a previous revision. Non-destructive — creates a new revision with the old content.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_listMedia
tools.description: List media files in a documentation project. Returns filenames, sizes, URLs, and markdown embed snippets.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentdocs_bulkCreatePages
tools.description: Bulk create or update multiple pages at once. Used for multi-page writes. Each page needs title, slug, content_md, commit_message.

pages.description: Array of page objects. Each object: title (required), slug (required), content_md (required), commit_message (required), path (optional tree location)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)
